messages:
Sam: saw a weird spike in invoice-preview tokens for a bunch of tenants starting ~09:12 UTC, looks correlated with last night's route-priority rollout. delta ~ +18% tokens for ephemeral sessions
Ben: can you paste the query and a sample event?
Sam: query (clickhouse):
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, count() as tokens, any(route) AS route
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR
AND session_id LIKE 'ephemeral:%'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50
```
Sam: sample log: `route=fastpath session_id=ephemeral:xyz123 req_id=... tokens=120` repeated twice for same req_id in <1s window
Rachel: hunch: route proxy started rewriting session_id to include timestamp fragment for affinity; that makes the KV-join treat same user as new session and double-count. I pushed a diff to the route-priority change explaining it might mutate ids.
Anya: if the proxy mutates ids we should normalize at the ingest boundary instead of changing all downstream joins. retrofixing invoices will be a mess.
BillingOps: if this went to invoices we'll need a backfill plan. we can credit affected accounts but need a deterministic way to identify dupes. 48h safe window for adjustments, beyond that requires accounting approvals.
Ben: propose a small shim at the API gateway that strips ephemeral timestamp suffix for the session_id header before it reaches metering. lightweight, feature-flagged, canary to 5% traffic.
Rachel: agree. example nginx lua snippet I sketched:
```lua
local sid = ngx.req.get_headers()["x-session-id"]
if sid and sid:match("^ephemeral:%w+:%d+$") then
  sid = sid:gsub(":%d+$", "")
  ngx.req.set_header("x-session-id", sid)
end
```
Ben: add metric `ingest.session_id_normalized{route}` increment when we rewrite, and a counter for `ingest.duplicated_req_seen`.
Sam: can we also add a lightweight dedupe on req_id at the metering preprocessor? TTL 2s -> dedupe exact req_id. should catch racey duplicate writes.
Anya: two parts then: (1) proxy shim to stop new variants, (2) short-ttl dedupe in preproc to remove any in-flight dupes. both behind flags.
BillingOps: timeline: if shim + dedupe are deployed today to staging and canary tomorrow, we can run a targeted backfill for tenants with high duplication and issue credits. please tag me on the backfill PR.
DeployBot: staging: deployed feature/shim-ephemeral-sid to staging at 2026-03-22T10:04Z :rocket:
Ben: for rollout UX, add a console toggle per-tenant (enable normalization) and a system-wide rollback flag. customers with custom proxies should be able to opt out.
Rachel: UX note: console toggle needs audit log + explanation: "Normalize ephemeral session ids (prevents duplicate token accounting when upstream mutates session ids)"
Sam: I'll open PRs: nginx-lua shim + preproc dedupe + metrics + dashboard card (ingest.session_id_normalized, ingest.dup_rate, invoice-preview-delta).
Anya: add a runbook entry: how to detect, how to toggle, backout steps, billing contacts.
BillingOps: thanks — once PRs link the sample query, we'll run a dry run backfill for two tenants and prepare credit notes.
Sam: filing PRs now, will post links + canary plan in this thread when ready :+1:
Ben: thanks all, prioritize observability on the new metric. set alert if normalized_rate > 0.5% of ingress per minute (early FYI).
DeployBot: canary: feature/shim-ephemeral-sid -> 5% prod at 2026-03-22T11:02Z
Sam: confirmed metric looks good in staging, starting canary tomorrow morning.
